findings.evidence: `grep -n 'have heq' TauCeti/Analysis/{PositiveDefinite,Bochner,Matrix}` lists the sites above. The file already does exactly this for two operations (`posSemidef_prod`, PosSemidef.lean:166-174, and `posSemidef_pow`, :177-189, each absorbing one `heq` internally so callers get the lambda form), so the pattern is established but applied to only two of the six operations; the deleted `isPositiveDefiniteKernel_comp`/`_mul`/`_add`/`_smul_of_nonneg`/`_sum` (Kernel/Basic.lean, Kernel/Closure.lean) provided precisely these.
findings.fix: Add pointwise-statement lemmas to TauCeti/Analysis/Matrix/PosSemidef.lean — `posSemidef_comp (hK : Matrix.PosSemidef K) (f : β → α) : Matrix.PosSemidef fun a b => K (f a) (f b)`, and the analogous pointwise `mul`/`add`/`smul`/`sum` — proving the transport once each, and replace the 14 inline blocks with applications.
findings.issue: Every downstream use of `Matrix.PosSemidef.submatrix`/`.hadamard`/`.add`/`.smul`/`Matrix.posSemidef_sum` now needs a hand-rolled equality between the matrix operation and its pointwise lambda, repeated 14 times: submatrix at SemigroupGroup/Basic.lean:168,178, Time/Axis.lean:66, Time/Slice.lean:69, Pullback.lean:86,116, Fourier/Convention.lean:123; hadamard at SemigroupGroup/Basic.lean:359, Product.lean:68, PosSemidef.lean:184; Pi add at SemigroupGroup/Basic.lean:326; smul at SemigroupGroup/Basic.lean:340, BochnerTheorem.lean:223; sum at PositiveDefinite/Basic.lean:288, SemigroupGroup/Basic.lean:373. This is substantial repeated reasoning that the new file was the place to factor out.

findings.evidence: PosSemidef.lean:108-114 opens `Matrix.PosSemidef (fun _ _ : α => c)` with `refine ⟨?_, fun x => ?_⟩` and closes the Hermitian field by `exact hHerm` where `hHerm : (Matrix.of fun _ _ : α => c).IsHermitian` — no `change` needed in either direction. Time/Axis.lean:66-72, Time/Slice.lean:69-75, Pullback.lean:86-93 all state `Matrix.submatrix … = fun … => …` with no `Matrix.of` on the RHS and close with `exact heq ▸ hK` against a bare-lambda `Matrix.PosSemidef` goal.
findings.fix: Drop the `change` at PosDef.lean:128 and build the structure directly on the lambda goal (as posSemidef_const_of_nonneg does). At Convention.lean:123-135, state `heq`'s RHS as the plain lambda `fun a b : W => ∫ q, fourierAtom (a - b) q ∂ν` (as all seven other submatrix transports do) and delete the `change` at :134.
findings.issue: `change (Matrix.of fun i j => charFun μ (t i - t j)).PosSemidef` is justified by the comment "Lean does not unfold the semireducible function-to-matrix identification while elaborating the `PosSemidef` structure fields", but the PR itself elaborates those fields on a bare-lambda goal without any `change`. The same applies at Fourier/Convention.lean:134, whose `change` is only needed because `heq`'s RHS was written with a redundant `Matrix.of`.

findings.evidence: `Matrix.hadamard_apply` exists at mathlib/Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/Matrix/Hadamard.lean:49; `Matrix.submatrix_apply` is the corresponding simp lemma in Mathlib/Data/Matrix/Basic. Sites confirmed by reading the cited lines.
findings.fix: Close these with `simp [Matrix.hadamard_apply]` and `simp [Pi.add_apply]` instead of `rfl`. Likewise prefer `Matrix.submatrix_apply` over passing the definition `Matrix.submatrix` to `simp` (Time/Axis.lean:71, Time/Slice.lean:74, Pullback.lean:92,122, SemigroupGroup/Basic.lean:173,183).
findings.issue: Four of the transport equalities are closed by `ext; rfl`, i.e. by unfolding a Mathlib definition definitionally where a named lemma exists: `Matrix.hadamard` at PosSemidef.lean:186-187, SemigroupGroup/Basic.lean:363-364 and Product.lean:72-73, and `Pi` addition at SemigroupGroup/Basic.lean:330-331. These break if Mathlib restates `Matrix.hadamard` (e.g. via a `map₂` combinator) even though the lemma statement stays true.

summary: The prior round's inconsistent idioms and Matrix.of peels are fixed, but the deleted kernel closure wrappers were replaced by ~14 open-coded `heq : <matrix op> = <lambda>` + `▸` transports instead of pointwise-form lemmas in the new Matrix/PosSemidef.lean, and the two surviving `change` steps carry justifications the PR's own proofs contradict.
